name: airwallex-agentos
description: Bring Airwallex's global financial infrastructure to Cursor. Orchestrate actions across your account in plain language, e.g., set up invoices from a PO, onboard suppliers from invoices, and check current cash position across currencies. AgentOS bundles pre-built finance Skills with MCP servers. A public CLI connects your agent to Airwallex's capabilities.
